About this item

  • TRENDY PLATFORM SNEAKER DESIGN – Elevate your everyday style with a fashion-forward platform silhouette that adds height without sacrificing comfort; perfect for casual outfits, streetwear looks, or weekend wear
  • ALL-DAY COMFORT & SUPPORT – Cushioned footbed and supportive sole provide lasting comfort whether you're running errands, commuting, or spending long hours on your feet. Runs slightly large. Recommend sizing down.
  • VERSATILE & EASY TO STYLE – Pairs effortlessly with jeans, leggings, dresses, or athleisure outfits, making it a go-to sneaker for multiple occasions
  • DURABLE CONSTRUCTION – Made with high-quality materials designed for everyday wear, offering long-lasting performance and reliable traction
  • LIGHTWEIGHT & BREATHABLE – Designed to keep your feet feeling fresh and comfortable throughout the day without feeling bulky or heavy

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers look exactly as pictured and receive many compliments, while also appreciating their comfort, true-to-size fit, and great value for money. The color receives positive feedback, with many loving the bright red shade, and customers consider them well-made. However, the fit is mixed, with some finding them true to size while others say they run narrow, and durability is a concern as the inside of the shoe starts to break down. The weight receives mixed reviews, with some finding them not too heavy while others consider them heavy.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Honest Review: Cloud-Like Pink Shoes ☁️💖
    Reviewed in the United States on October 1, 2025
    Size: 9Color: Bright Pink
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    These bubblegum-pink kicks are hands-down the cutest—and the comfiest—pair I’ve ever slipped on. The moment I stepped in, the ultra-soft, memory-foam footbed cradled every curve of my foot, making me feel like I was walking on clouds. The breathable knit upper gently hugs your foot without pinching, while the responsive foam midsole cushions each stride, whether you’re dashing to brunch or strolling around campus.

    Despite their plush feel, they’re surprisingly lightweight and flexible. The textured outsole grips pavement and tile alike, so I’ve tackled errands, workouts, and weekend adventures without fear of slipping or leg fatigue. And the rich pink hue isn’t just pastel—it’s perfectly saturated, adding a cheerful pop to any outfit.

    I’m already eyeing the same style in navy, mint, and even the seasonal lavender drop. Trust me, once you experience cloud-walking in these, you’ll want a pair for every mood and moment.

    Pros

    Memory-foam footbed cushions every step

    Breathable knit upper hugs without rubbing

    Lightweight, flexible design for all-day wear

    Traction-ready outsole for stability on varied surfaces

    Vibrant pink shade adds fun to any look

    Cons

    Knit material may collect lint if stored carelessly

    Foam midsole shows wear after very intense running sessions

    Styling & Next Steps

    Pair with cropped jeans and a white tee for an effortless weekend vibe

    Slip on with athleisure leggings and a hoodie for post-gym comfort

    Opt for pastel socks to highlight the knit texture and color contrast

    Rotate between colors—mint green and sky blue are perfect summer picks!

    If you crave shoes that feel like a dream underfoot and look downright adorable, these pink cloud-walkers are a must. I’ll definitely be back for every shade in the collection!

  • Missy
    3 out of 5 stars
    So cute but you can’t wear socks without causing blisters
    Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026
    Size: 7Color: Light Blue
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I’m on the fence with these. They are really cute. They are a bit snug in width. I’m a size 7 and they fit fine other than narrow. Not too uncomfortable though and should stretch. No arch support if that’s what you need. The issue is, if I wear socks the back above your heel part lifts when your toe touches down when I walk. There’s just no flexibility in the sole because of the platform. Tightening the laces helped but I’m sure you would have to constantly do that and that’s annoying. And they still slipped a little. I tried lower socks and thinner socks and basically if the sock is between your skin and the shoe it will slip around. If you’re just standing around, adorable. If you actually want to walk around with socks, there’s gonna be a problem. I tried them without socks and they’re much better. I personally just prefer socks with sneakers, so I’m still debating keeping them.

About this Item

  • TRENDY PLATFORM SNEAKER DESIGN – Elevate your everyday style with a fashion-forward platform silhouette that adds height without sacrificing comfort; perfect for casual outfits, streetwear looks, or weekend wear
  • ALL-DAY COMFORT & SUPPORT – Cushioned footbed and supportive sole provide lasting comfort whether you're running errands, commuting, or spending long hours on your feet. Runs slightly large. Recommend sizing down.
  • VERSATILE & EASY TO STYLE – Pairs effortlessly with jeans, leggings, dresses, or athleisure outfits, making it a go-to sneaker for multiple occasions
  • DURABLE CONSTRUCTION – Made with high-quality materials designed for everyday wear, offering long-lasting performance and reliable traction
  • LIGHTWEIGHT & BREATHABLE – Designed to keep your feet feeling fresh and comfortable throughout the day without feeling bulky or heavy

Product Description

Striped with sporty fashion, the Navida sneakers from Madden Girl lace up a low-top silhouette on fresh platforms.
